title: Plant varieties
description: What is specific to plants, and nothing more. Name, originator, claimed creation date, identification evidence and external registrations are envelope fields, because a livestock herd book and a culture collection need them too. This profile is small on purpose: the smaller it is, the less a body adopting the format has to agree with us about.

propagationType.description: Determines whether a voucher specimen is practical to store, which is the difficulty this format exists to work around for vegetatively propagated material.

sportOrigin.description: Where a variety arose as a sport on an existing one. Common in ornamentals and fruit, and a common dispute.
